title: Utilitiez
description: A mod that aims to add basically, weapons, armor and more.
body:
# 📋 What's Utilitiez?
Utilitiez is a mod that aims to add more items to minecraft, more blocks, armor and weapons. It is basically a mod that adds, well, utilities.

## ➕ Additions
This mod adds:
* Ruby ore, along with Ruby Armor & Tools
* Emerald Tools & Armor
* More Paintings
* Custom Biomes & structures
* Alot of ores!
